storage.aboutRoots:
Our story begins with our foundation, our Root: The Great Ancestor - Guvaza.

Guvaza is the father and founder of our house. From his strength, values and name, our family was born.

From Guvaza came his children: Rutambo, Vurayai, Svusvu, VaFonjo and many more - forgotten and unrecorded at this point - who continued the bloodline and carried our heritage forward. This is the sacred lineage that connects us all - from the root to the branches, we are one.

The Guvaza Family Trust was established to honor this lineage. Our mission is threefold:

1. To Preserve Our Heritage - To never forget who we are and where we come from.

2. To Build Wealth Together - Through our family companies, we create financial security and opportunity for every member.

3. To Keep Our Family United - To ensure that no matter where we are, we remain united under one vision, one trust, and one
   name.

This Trust is our promise to the past and our gift to the future. We are the Guvaza Family.

storage.guvaza_about_text:
Our story begins with our foundation, our Root: The Great Ancestor - Guvaza.

Guvaza is the father and founder of our house. From his strength, values and name, our family was born.

From Guvaza came his children: Rutambo, Vurayai, Svusvu, VaFonjo and many more - forgotten and unrecorded at this point - who continued the bloodline and carried our heritage forward. This is the sacred lineage that connects us all - from the root to the branches, we are one.

The Guvaza Family Trust was established to honor this lineage. Our mission is threefold:

1. To Preserve Our Heritage - To never forget who we are and where we come from.

2. To Build Wealth Together - Through our family companies, we create financial security and opportunity for every member.

3. To Keep Our Family United - To ensure that no matter where we are, we remain united under one vision, one trust, and one
   name.

This Trust is our promise to the past and our gift to the future. We are the Guvaza Family.
